deliverables: Secondary ticket resale marketplace settling transactions on-chain
Smart-contract royalty enforcement for artists and venues
Per-event anti-scalping controls including price ceilings, transfer limits, identity-binding, and time restrictions
Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's existing user flow
Organizer tools for resale parameters, ticket lifecycle data, royalty distributions, and ticket verification
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with published report and remediation
Public launch campaign including Big Storm marketing and three trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard, quarterly reports, and final governance report
request.recipient: Intersect as budget administrator, with funds administered through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework for Anvil/Sellout project delivery.
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Phase 2 of a Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and includes on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout has invested over $130,000 of its own capital into Phase 1.
The requested withdrawal is 4,969,231 ada, described as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee, over 8 months.

Phase 2 is projected to deliver 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The proposer commits that 25% of all fees will be sent to the Treasury until $1,093,231 is reimbursed, then reduced to a permanent 5% fee, with quarterly public reporting.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment and is projected to move over $6 million through Cardano in Year 1.
Funds are proposed to be milestone-gated through Intersect and the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework, with independent oversight and public dashboard tracking.
Anvil claims a track record of 250+ Cardano projects delivered, 456,000+ assets minted, 50,000,000+ ADA staked through Anvil infrastructure, and 267,000+ on-chain transactions.
Sellout is described as having 200,000+ registered users, 250,000+ tickets issued to date, and 350+ events annually at current cadence.
The proposal states that Anvil/Sellout have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests a large milestone-gated treasury withdrawal for a commercial ticketing platform expansion, with claimed existing mainnet work, projected adoption, revenue-share repayment, and Intersect/TRSC/PSSC administration, but many core adoption and track-record claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
